component.name: BetterShot
component.summary: Capture, edit, and share your screen

description.p: BetterShot takes screenshots of an area, the whole screen, or a window. Select from a still frame of your screen, adjust the area, and capture it at full resolution.
Each capture stays private in a floating card until you copy, save, or drag it into another app. Captures can also be saved to your Screenshots folder automatically.

The editor adds arrows, shapes, text, numbered markers, highlights, blur, and pixelation, crops, rotates, and flips, and frames screenshots with gradient or image backgrounds, padding, rounded corners, and shadows. Edits stay editable after saving.
